narrative.overview: The digital presence is a prepared infant-care shelf: pale greige plaster, matte linen, soft wood edges, and a single warm amber register borrowed from a backlit studio arch. The page should feel like walking up to a station that has already been laid out for you — ritual precision without clinical chill, quiet luxury without cream-spa cliché.
keyCharacteristics: Cool greige plaster ground (not warm cream)
Amber as the only saturated action color (≤10% of any screen)
Arch-framed imagery as the signature container
Shelf / station rhythm instead of marketing card stacks
Light mode only for marketing — the studio is daylight plaster

rules.name: The Amber Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on primary actions and small active states only. Greige and linen own the field.

rules.name: The No Sage / No Cream Rule
rules.body: Do not revive the previous misted-sage primary or warm limewash cream ground. This world is cooler plaster with one warm light.

rules.name: The Serif Threshold Rule
rules.body: Gloock for brand moments and headings only — never form labels, errors, or admin tables.

dos: Do keep marketing light, greige, and arch-led.
Do reserve amber for Book and active states.
Do author infant-station imagery; never use the private BubbleBliss photo on the live site.
Do stage modalities as shelf labels / ritual steps, not three equal icon cards.
donts: Don't use Cormorant Garamond, Literata, Figtree, DM Sans, sage green, or warm cream as brand materials.
Don't invent testimonials, prices, or a street address.
Don't put cards, badges, or promo stickers on the hero image.
Don't use urgency theater or clinical hospital blue.
